days.headline: Operation: Cross the Pond
days.briefing: The deployment begins on two fronts. Hanna flies Business from BWI (FI 642), while the Plebs (Prok, Max, Troy) depart IAD on FI 644. Everyone reconnects in Iceland for FI 470 into London Gatwick.

food.name: Airport / Airplane Cuisine
food.vibe: Lounge food for Royalty; terminal and cabin food for the Plebs.

highlights.title: Boys flight to London
highlights.summary:
• Economy class, Prok, Max, Troy. 
  • FI 644: 20:40 IAD to 06:35 KEF

highlights.title: Hanna flight to London
highlights.summary:
• Business Class
  • F1 642: 20:40 BWI to KEF

days.headline: The Crown Jewels & The Medieval Fortress
days.briefing: Touch down at Gatwick, Thameslink into London Bridge, grab a Ginger Pig sausage roll, drop bags at Apex City of London, then dive straight into the Tower of London and a surviving stretch of Roman London Wall before dinner at The Lampery.

food.name: The Ginger Pig
food.vibe: Bustling, premium grab-and-go butcher/deli vibe. Expect to eat standing or while walking.

highlights.title: LGW Passport Control
highlights.summary: LGW Passport Control

highlights.title: Tower of London
highlights.summary:
• A nearly 1,000-year-old fortress and former prison that houses the glittering Crown Jewels, guarded by the iconic Yeoman Warders (Beefeaters). 
  • Try to catch the 14:30 or 15:00 Yeoman Warder tour.

highlights.title: Dinner at The Lampery
highlights.summary: Lively classic Victorian tavern; freshly prepared pub food / fish and chips.

days.headline: Hogwarts & The Phantom of the Opera
days.briefing: Full English Breakfast at the hotel, then Leavesden for Harry Potter Studios. Afternoon branches: Oxford (if weather is good) or St Paul's + Piccadilly shopping. Finish the day with Phantom of the Opera at 19:30.

food.name: The Backlot Café
food.vibe: Studio cafeteria; loud, crowded, and heavily themed.

highlights.title: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London — The Making of Harry Potter
highlights.summary: Housed at working Leavesden studios where all eight Harry Potter films were produced over ten years.

highlights.title: Taxi to Oxford University
highlights.summary: 60–90 min depending on traffic. Schedule in advance. Drop directly at Magdalen College (closes earliest).

highlights.title: Piccadilly / Regent Street / Carnaby Shopping
highlights.summary:
• Walk west down Piccadilly street to browse Fortnum & Mason, the historic department store that has operated as the official royal grocer since 1707.
  • Walk north up the sweeping curve of Regent Street for major global flagship stores, tech, and high-end fashion.
  • Walk northeast into Carnaby Street for boutique, pedestrian-only heritage fashion.

highlights.title: Dinner at Brasserie Zédel
highlights.summary: 1930s Parisian Art Deco basement. Prix fixe — steak haché and profiteroles.

highlights.title: Phantom of the Opera
highlights.summary: Phantom of the Opera

days.headline: Kings, Queens & Shakespeare's Globe
days.briefing: Early Westminster photo loop with light crowds, then Westminster Abbey, Officers Inspection at Horse Guards, Buckingham Palace walk, Globe & Golden Hind, Tower Bridge, and dinner at The George Inn.

food.name: Regency Cafe & The George Inn
food.vibe: Traditional British comfort food for lunch; 17th-century pub where Shakespeare and Dickens drank for dinner.
food.mustTry: British breakfast / local ale & fish and chips

highlights.title: The London family picture
highlights.summary: Big Ben, Westminster, River Thames — limited crowds. Wear formal/nice attire.

highlights.title: Queen Elizabeth Tower / Big Ben
highlights.summary: Iconic clock tower

highlights.title: Westminster Abbey
highlights.summary: Most important/significant church in Britian, where queens and kings have been crowned, married, and buried since 1066

highlights.title: Horse Guards Parade / Officers Inspection
highlights.summary:
• Iconic red-coat guards
  • Officers Inspection 11:00–11:10 Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun (come 10 minutes early)

highlights.title: Buckingham Palace
highlights.summary: King's official London residence — facade, gates, Queen Victoria Memorial, St James's Park Blue Bridge.

highlights.title: Shakespeare's Globe
highlights.summary:
• Replica of Shakespeare's famous Elizabethan theatre.
  • Tickets emailed the day before

highlights.title: Tower Bridge
highlights.summary: The striking Victorian suspension and drawbridge with the two massive neo-Gothic towers.  The good looking bridge, London bridge is the lest impressive bridge west of it

highlights.title: Dinner at The George Inn
highlights.summary: 17th-century pub — Shakespeare and Dickens drank here.

days.headline: Ancient Empires & The Jump to France
days.briefing: Morning branches: British Museum (full family) or Oxford exteriors + Magdalen (Hanna + Max only). Converge at Blacklock for Sunday Roast, grab bags from Bounce, then Eurostar from St Pancras to Paris and check in at Pullman Paris Centre-Bercy.

food.name: Blacklock (Covent Garden)
food.vibe: Upscale yet unpretentious mid-century British chophouse.
food.mustTry: The "All-In" Roast — trimmings, unlimited gravy, cauliflower cheese, white chocolate cheesecake

highlights.title: The British Museum
highlights.summary: First public national museum in the world. Rosetta Stone, Lamassu, Elgin Marbles, Standard of Ur, Sutton Hoo, Lewis Chessmen.

highlights.title: Lunch at Blacklock (Covent Garden)
highlights.summary: Converge — must have Sunday Roast.

highlights.title: Eurostar London → Paris
highlights.summary: Eurostar London → Paris

highlights.title: Drop off laundry
highlights.summary: Drop off laundry

days.headline: The Mona Lisa, Stained Glass & The Unknown Soldier
days.briefing: Palais Royal columns and Le Pain Quotidien, then the Louvre via Arc du Carrousel, Sainte-Chapelle, Vedettes du Pont Neuf Seine cruise, Notre-Dame, and the 18:30 rekindling of the flame at the Arc de Triomphe.

food.name: Merci Jérôme Pont-Neuf / L'Auberge Aveyronnaise
food.vibe: Scenic lunch near the Louvre; old-school Auvergne countryside hospitality for dinner.
food.mustTry: Subs at lunch; traditional Auvergne sausages & thick-cut steaks at dinner

highlights.title: The Louvre
highlights.summary: Largest art museum in the world, 35,000 art pieces

highlights.title: Sainte-Chapelle
highlights.summary:
• Beautiful glass church. 
  • Airport security lines — 15–30 min to get in.

highlights.title: Vedettes du Pont Neuf Seine River Cruise
highlights.summary: Relaxing boat trip viewing historic bridges and monuments.

highlights.title: Notre-Dame Cathedral
highlights.summary: A medieval Catholic cathedral that took 200 years to build. It burned down in 2019 and reopened in Dec 2024 following a massive restoration.

highlights.title: Shopping — Avenue Montaigne / Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré
highlights.summary: Head to the nearby Avenue Montaigne or Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, which offer a significantly more refined and quieter shopping environment

highlights.title: Dinner at L'Auberge Aveyronnaise
highlights.summary: Dinner at L'Auberge Aveyronnaise

days.headline: The Sun King's Palace, Catacombs & The Eiffel Tower
days.briefing: Sunrise family picture at Trocadéro, croissants at Carette, full Versailles day (Hall of Mirrors + gardens), sunset from the Eiffel Tower 2nd floor, then the Catacombs.

food.name: Carette (Trocadéro)
food.vibe: Classic Parisian — famous hot chocolate; line moves quick.
food.mustTry: Hot chocolate & croissant with whipped cream

highlights.title: Eiffel tower picture at Trocadéro
highlights.summary: Wear formal attire. Iconic sunrise view of the Eiffel Tower.

highlights.title: Palace of Versailles
highlights.summary: Opulent royal palace of Louis XIV. Residence of the king and seat of government for over 100 years

highlights.title: Eiffel Tower
highlights.summary: Paris's iconic 1889 wrought-iron centerpiece. Ride the elevator or climb the stairs for the best panoramic views of the city.

highlights.title: Catacombs of Paris
highlights.summary: Underground tunnels in Paris lined with the bones of over 6 million people

highlights.title: Dinner TBD
highlights.summary: Dinner TBD

highlights.title: Pick up laundry
highlights.summary: Pick up laundry

days.headline: Arrival in the Eternal City & The Ancient Oculus
days.briefing: Early Orly flight TO 3910 into FCO. Italy's National Unity Day — free museums, packed streets, Piazza Venezia ceremony. Drop bags at Casa Modelli, then three Pantheon queue options before converging on Piazza Mattei pizza masterclass.

food.name: Pizza e Mozzarella / Piazza Mattei
food.vibe: Casual takeaway Margherita for lunch; hands-on Roman cooking class with wine for dinner.
food.mustTry: Fresh Pizza Margherita; handmade pizza, supplì, and gelato from scratch

highlights.title: Pantheon
highlights.summary: A nearly 2,000-year-old former Roman temple, famous for its massive unreinforced concrete dome and the open oculus at its center

highlights.title: Ponte Umberto I
highlights.summary: Perfect sunset view of St. Peter's — must be at sunset or at night.

highlights.title: Spanish Steps
highlights.summary: Monumental 135-step stairway from the 1700s that bridges the Piazza di Spagna up to the Trinità dei Monti church

highlights.title: Trevi Fountain
highlights.summary: Iconic Baroque fountain completed in 1762

highlights.title: Pizza & Gelato Cooking Class
highlights.summary: Pizza, supplì, and gelato from scratch. Free-flowing fine Italian wine (Hanna).

days.headline: Gladiators, Emperors & The Mega-Baths
days.briefing: Early Colosseum family picture from Largo Gaetana Agnesi, then Forum, Palatine, Colosseum interior, Baths of Caracalla, Circus Maximus, Capitoline, Trajan's Column, and the Altar of the Fatherland rooftop.

food.name: La Nuova Piazzetta (Monti)
food.vibe: Authentic, blunt, and quick Roman service away from the mega-crowds.
food.mustTry: Traditional Roman pastas (carbonara / cacio e pepe)

highlights.title: Pictures at Largo Gaetana Agnesi
highlights.summary: The family Rome picture with Colosseum in the background

highlights.title: Arch of Constantine
highlights.summary: Largest still standing in Rome

highlights.title: Colosseum
highlights.summary: Most famous roman monument

highlights.title: Baths of Caracalla
highlights.summary: The second largest public baths in Ancient Rome

highlights.title: Altar of the Fatherland
highlights.summary: Colossal white marble monument honoring a unified Italy's first king

highlights.title: Dinner at Da Cicero
highlights.summary: Dinner at Da Cicero

days.headline: The Sistine Chapel, Massive Domes & A Papal Fortress
days.briefing: Uber to St Peter's early (knees and shoulders covered, passports), climb the dome, walk the Vatican walls to the Museums & Sistine Chapel, then Castel Sant'Angelo and afternoon shopping near Trevi / Via dei Coronari.

food.name: Vatican Museum Coffee Shop / Borghiciana Pastificio
food.vibe: Hectic rest-stop cafeteria espresso; small artisan pasta shop for lunch.

highlights.title: St. Peter's Basilica
highlights.summary: The largest and most spectacular basilica globally, St. Peters burial

highlights.title: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
highlights.summary: Church headquarters featuring Michelangelo masterpieces

highlights.title: Castel Sant'Angelo
highlights.summary: Hadrian mausoleum, castle, papal residence, prison.

highlights.title: Shopping — Rinascente / Via del Governo Vecchio / Via dei Coronari
highlights.summary: Rinascente by Trevi (Gucci, Alexander McQueen). Get snacks for tomorrow.

highlights.title: Dinner at Ristorante Grano
highlights.summary: Dinner at Ristorante Grano

days.headline: A City Frozen in Ash & The Volcano Summit
days.briefing: Meet at Piazza del Popolo for the tour bus to Pompeii — guide, Neapolitan lunch with Bay of Naples views, then hike Mt. Vesuvius before returning to Rome for dinner at ADEVA.

food.name: Tour lunch / ADEVA Cucina Moderna
food.vibe: Three-course Neapolitan lunch with Bay views; cozy modern dinner back in Rome.
food.mustTry: Authentic Neapolitan pizza; beef carpaccio, calamari, ragù with thyme

highlights.title: Tour bus to Pompeii
highlights.summary: Tour bus to Pompeii

highlights.title: Pompeii
highlights.summary: Ancient Roman commercial hub perfectly preserved under volcanic ash following the catastrophic eruption in 8/24/79 AD

highlights.title: Mt. Vesuvius
highlights.summary: The active stratovolcano responsible for burying Pompeii and Herculaneum.

highlights.title: Dinner at ADEVA Cucina Moderna
highlights.summary: Dinner at ADEVA Cucina Moderna

days.headline: The Journey Home
days.briefing: Leonardo Express to FCO. Everyone flies FI 931 FCO→KEF in Economy, then FI 645 KEF→IAD — Hanna back in Business for the long leg; boys remain Economy. Home ~20:00.

food.name: Hotel / Terminal / Airplane
food.vibe: Final espresso at the hotel; airport and cabin food thereafter.
